name: @northcinder/orders
description: NorthCinder order graph: merges checkout order records with deterministically parsed order/shipping/return emails — no LLM parsing anywhere (determinism law). Deterministic per-merchant/per-format parser plugins + generic fallback; unparseable mail lands as a structured unparsed record, never dropped. Return-window ICS export + reminder (reuses @northcinder/watches Notifier).
